name: Davidson Current
scope: California-Oregon winter coastal reference corridor between OSW gates at 35 N and 46 N. These are bookkeeping gates, not source-published current endpoints. Excludes conditional Vancouver Island penetration and the deeper California Undercurrent. No full-system length or width footprint.
layer: Seasonal northward surface-current regional context; not the separately described California Undercurrent below 200 m or a reconstructed velocity axis.
time_convention: October-March California-Oregon regional seasonal description in the February 1978 report; strongest flow described in January. Historical summary, not a dated trajectory, current-year observation or modern monthly climatology.
source_locator: Appendix II section II.1, printed II-1 to II-2 / PDF pages 12-13: northward seasonal surface strip along California and Oregon from October to March; Vancouver Island penetration is conditional.
source_citation: Fisheries and Environment Canada, Working Group on West Coast Deepwater Oil Ports (1978), Potential Pacific Coast Oil Ports: A Comparative Environmental Risk Analysis, Volume II - Supplementary Appendices, February 1978.
coordinate_selection: OSW selects all coastal-offshore vertices and regional gates at 35 N and 46 N. Source supplies California-Oregon scope, northward surface flow and October-March season but no coordinate axis, exact origin/termination or measured length. Alternative 34 N/45.5 N gates test regional endpoint convention. Source approximate 64 km width is separate regional context, never a route buffer; 25/50 km off Tofino are station offsets. No source figure digitized.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Alternative OSW California approach and northern Oregon gate; neither is a measured current boundary.

scenario_rule: Two regional gate conventions crossed with longitude and independent endpoint latitude offsets -0.05/0/+0.05 degrees: 54 editorial scenarios, not seasonal variation or observed endpoint/width uncertainty.
method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
map_land_check: All 54 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.
